findings.reason: the done-when must say "each figure file's exported ratio" and require the before/after size-and-ratio listing, or a worker closes the node on a measure undefined for part of its own set and skips the record that documents the size change.
findings.text: the ratio invariant is quantified over "each file", which includes receipts and previews that have no width-to-height, while the record the plan does ask for (each vector figure's declared size before and after) is named only in the delivered paragraph and never required by the done-when, so a worker can satisfy the stated measure without listing the sizes, and cannot say what the measure even means for a non-figure file

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — imas_codex/plotting/, scripts/, docs/figures/ and the s1 link all resolve in the tree; the shared save's fixed-width-and-derived-height behaviour is exactly what line 38 and s1 describe.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — s2's new ratio clause (line 48) asserts "each file's width-to-height ratio is unchanged", a set that also holds receipts and previews with no width or height, and the delivered before/after size record is not asked for by the done-when.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the section's records land in the landing record, the repository's own durable record path; the work is 3.5 h of local edits and regeneration under docs/figures/, not a scratch tree.
rubric_items.naming: pass — s2 names no code paths, symbols or tracker labels; no plan label reaches anything a worker would build.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated defect matches the code (width is substituted with a fixed 31.1cm while height is derived, so a canvas drawn at 18 in or 20 in wide would come out with a wrong ratio), the endpoint is obtainable and the ratio check can fail on today's shared function, and s2 prescribes no code path or step sequence.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s2 has one deliverable: scripts reach the shared export with files equivalent to today's; the physical-size sentence is a consequence of that export, not a second goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the node table's only relationship, s2 depends-on figure-scripts-use-the-shared-save-function#s1, resolves and points at the section that owns the corrected export.
